Last year, Jim McGuinness' dream of leading Donegal to the All-Ireland title in his first year back ended in semi-final heartache with defeat by Galway.
On July 27, Kerry, the 2022 title holder, will compete against the victors of the semi-final match between Donegal and Meath, scheduled for Sunday at 16:00 BST.
